brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
President Tebboune commended progress on the Bled El Hadba-Oued Keberit-Annaba Port Mining Railway Project and work under the National Climate Change Adaptation Plan. [3][4]
Algeria launched a nationwide drive to reclaim unused investment land. [5]

WATCH ITEMS
Whether Algeria will join the Mecca Agreement by December 31, 2027, as priced at 10% on a Polymarket market closing Jan 1, 2028. [E4]
